name: @khorsheed/dsh-typesafe
description: TypeSafe (System One / Jev) decision primitives as a host service: typed noul/choice/score judgements through one named-question registry, with credential-reference key resolution, bounded timeout, retry, circuit breaker, cache and decision logs. Other plugins call it in code; the model-facing tool row ships separately in @khorsheed/dsh-typesafe-tool.

compat.notes: Provides a host-plane service and no model-facing surface, so it composes at the profile root. Key resolution reads the host credential store per call (ctx.credentials.resolve) and every outbound call is bounded: owned timeout + AbortSignal, 429/529 exponential backoff, circuit breaker, optional cache. A composition without the credentials service leaves the row pending rather than failing boot.
